digest.component_or_area: plan-review reviewer prompts and criteria routing index
propositions: Reviewer prompts pool the two headings Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria and apply a single bar, making the dual vocabulary noise in the rubrics.
Rename Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria throughout the listed reviewer prompts and the criteria routing index, then regenerate the criteria guide from them.
G3's two bare SC tokens are renamed by hand rather than by pattern because a word-boundary SC match also hits O-RAN-SC.
plan_review_T2.md and the dod_uncertifiable wording in the verifier prompts are deliberately excluded because their phrasing is generic English, not the ticket heading.
Editing criteria_routing.json rotates the regver stamp and invalidates outstanding plan-review attestations, so the edit depends on the grandfathering ticket having merged first.
A test captures registry_version before and after the routing edit and asserts inequality to prove the rotation by construction.
